title: Correction to a signed record
description: A machine-written change to a record in eval/gold/, made on the owner's instruction (ADR-0120, ADR-0122) and never inside the signature. eval/gold/ stays byte-for-byte frozen as the measurement yardstick; what serves — the graph, recognition, search and the explorer — applies the correction. Every correction carries the authoring envelope, so it is unreviewed and says who wrote it, and names the owner's ruling it acts on. A concept or entity is patched field by field; a relationship is replaced by an authored relationship that carries the corrected triple.

corrects.description: The signed record this corrects. It must exist in eval/gold/.

add.description: Values added to list fields of a signed concept. Each added value is machine-written and is stated in the authored graph, never the approved one.

remove.description: Values withdrawn from list fields of a signed concept. Each must be present on the signed record. The signed record keeps it; nothing that serves states it.

set.description: Single fields a correction may set. Deliberately narrow: a concept's preferred label is not here, because two preferred labels would sit on one concept in the merged graph.

replaced_by.description: For a relationship: the authored relationship that carries the corrected triple. The signed record stays as history; its direct triple stops being served.

ruling.description: The owner's ruling this acts on: a ruling file and the item, e.g. review/rulings/2026-10-08-chat-ontology-review.yaml#D2.
